source_refs.note: (iii)- Tubular Secretion: a main subheading of 14.1.3 Functioning of Kidney, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 16-16.

blocks.text: Tubular secretion reabsorption ka ulat hai. Is amal mein renal tubule ke epithelial cells (zyada tar proximal convoluted tubule ke, aur distal convoluted tubule aur collecting duct ke bhi) aas paas ke khoon se kuch cheezen le kar filtrate mein dal dete hain. In cheezon mein hydrogen ions, ammonium, potassium ions, aur mukhtalif metabolic zehreele madde ya dawaon ke baqiyat (maslan penicillin) shamil hain. Hydrogen ions ki tubular secretion se gurde khoon ka acid-base tawazun (pH) qaim rakhne mein kirdar ada karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan secretion sirf distal convoluted tubule mein batati hai. Asal mein secretion zyada tar proximal tubule mein hoti hai (H+, ammonium, zehreele madde aur penicillin jaisi kai dawaen wahin secrete hoti hain), aur distal convoluted tubule aur collecting duct mein bhi (K+ aur H+). Oopar sahi baat likhi gayi hai.
